jobs.title: Policy Fellow Klimamigration (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: The posting requires at least five years of relevant experience ("Mindestens fünf Jahre einschlägige Arbeitserfahrung werden vorausgesetzt") plus an established policy network and fundraising track record — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, a hard disqualifier. Although DGAP and the climate/foreign-policy security angle sit in a genuinely interesting zone, the seniority is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft in den Literatur- und Oralturpraktiken (w/m/d/k)
jobs.reason: This is a Studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy regardless of fit. It also requires current enrolment in a literature/art/culture programme and cultural-management experience, which sit outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Praktikum in den Literatur- und Oralturpraktiken für die Reihe Middle Ground (m/w/d/k)
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum) requiring current enrolment in a humanities / arts / cultural-management programme, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, focusing on literary/cultural festival production rather than international law, security or policy research.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im Power4Just Transition Programm
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum), which is excluded as a matter of policy regardless of fit. It also requires current enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months, further underlining the student-only nature of the post.

jobs.title: technische Produktionsassistenz Berlinale (m/w/d/k)
jobs.reason: Requires a completed degree in event/culture management plus several years of professional experience in event safety and technical production planning, along with specialist knowledge of fire safety, occupational safety and procurement law — none of which the candidate has. This is a technical events-management role well outside all three interest zones and fails on both level and essential skills.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in für Kommunikation, Event- und Wissensmanagement für die Team Europe Initiative zu entwaldungsfreien Wertschöpfungsketten
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship (Praktikum) requiring current enrolment, which is a hard-disqualifier under the policy excluding internships. The comms/event/design focus is also a partial skills gap and the development-cooperation topic sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Kommunikation, Event-Management, Wissensmanagement (ProSoil)
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly labelled internship (Praktikum), which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also targets communications/media or agricultural/environmental backgrounds with events and social-media experience, outside both the candidate's profile and interest zones.
